questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did the 1993–94 Seattle SuperSonics win?
questions.note: 63 victories, before a shocking first-round elimination.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: league-best 63–19 record

funFacts.text: Seattle acquired two-time Sixth Man of the Year Detlef Schrempf from Indiana before the season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: acquired All-Star forward, and 2-time Sixth Man of the Year Detlef Schrempf from the Indiana Pacers

funFacts.text: The Sonics also traded for Kendall Gill from Charlotte that offseason.

questions.prompt: The 1966–67 Sixers’ 50-game start is still tied for the best ever. How many of those 50 did they lose?
questions.note: Just four: 46–4. The 2015–16 Warriors later matched it.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 76ers started the season at 46–4, which remains the best 50-game start in the NBA history

funFacts.text: The 1966–67 start would eventually be matched by Golden State's celebrated 2015–16 regular season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: remains the best 50-game start in the NBA history (though tied in the Warriors 2015-16 season)

questions.prompt: In Memphis's 2022 playoff showdown against Steph Curry's Warriors, how many points did Ja Morant score in Game 2?
